name: AgentRedTeam
summary: A crash-test tool for AI agents. It stress-tests them before you trust them with real users.
tags: Python · FastAPI · Gemini · Groq · PostgreSQL · Docker · GCP Cloud Run · GitHub Actions
points: 15 attack types generated by Gemini and fired at any agent over one HTTP endpoint.
Rule-based scoring first, then an LLM judge, rolled into a 0 to 100 trust score.
95 automated tests; the full suite runs in 0.4 seconds.
